title: KbRagInput
description: Read from the merged `{ ...ctx.config, ...ctx.inputs }` bag (inputs win) — a chain may supply either, so nothing is `required` here; the SURFACE refuses a missing or unusable key with a typed `validation_error` (a node failure, never success-with-empty).

orgId.description: The org that owns the collection. A cross-org id is simply not found (the service enforces the tenant+org key).

collectionId.description: The KB collection to act on.

topK.description: How many chunks to return. Absent ⇒ the host default (`DEFAULT_TOP_K` = 8); present-but-unusable is a typed failure, never a silent fallback.
